summary: triphasic = special case of multiphasic (solvent + pair of monovalent ions). Requires global R, θ, and Faraday's constant Fc under `<Constants>`, plus `<Solutes>` entries. To neglect osmotic effects set Φ = 0 (then p̃ = p). A solute with mixture diffusivity dσ = 0 and free diffusivity dσ_0 = 1 behaves like a solid-bound molecule.
manual_ref: FEBio 4.x User Manual §4.16.2 General Specification of Multiphasic Materials, p362（4.13）

phi0.meaning: solid volume fraction φs_r in the reference configuration

fixed_charge_density.meaning: fixed charge density cF_r in the reference configuration
fixed_charge_density.range: may be negative, positive, or zero

permeability.meaning: specification of the hydraulic permeability k (§4.14.2)

solvent_supply.meaning: specification of the solvent supply φ̂w (§4.16.3)

osmotic_coefficient.meaning: specification of the osmotic coefficient Φ (§4.15.5)

solute.meaning: specification of the solute properties (required `sol` attribute; multiple allowed)

solid_bound.meaning: specification of solid-bound molecule (required `sbm` attribute referencing an id in `<Globals><SolidBoundMolecules>`; multiple allowed)

rho0.meaning: (child of `solid_bound`) initial value of the referential apparent density ρσ_r
rho0.note: 手册列出该参数，但 pyfebio 当前版本没有对应字段，建模时无法传入。

example.verified_note: 已在 FEBio 4.13.0 实测：包进 1×1×1 六面体网格、单轴压缩 1% 的算例，terminate normal。该结果只证明此 spec 可被 FEBio 正常读入并收敛，不代表参数取值适用于任何具体工况。
